explication: Nextcloud Talk is a Nextcloud audio/video conferencing and messaging app. Users open or create a conversation, invite or join participants, then chat and participate in calls; the app also supports federation, polls, integrations and administration. The graph shows the documented product branches and core backend layers. Several frontend and integration paths come from the README or tree rather than sampled implementation, so those relationships are marked unverified where appropriate.
